patches.summary: Added g2OAuthScopes() helper and an 'auth scopes' subcommand that surfaces every OAuth scope declared by the G2 v2 spec.
patches.reason: The G2 spec calls for openid, profile, buyer_intent.read, screenshots.read, product_features.read, market_signals.read, data_subscriptions.read, data_subscriptions.read_write, and partner:partner-id.read across 29 operations. Without surfacing these in auth.go, the dogfood OAuth scope coverage gate failed (0/29). Users registering OAuth apps in the G2 developer portal also need to know which scopes to request.
patches.validated_outcome: Polish dogfood verdict: FAIL -> PASS (OAuth scope coverage 29/29).

patches.summary: Added mcp-descriptions.json overrides for two thin tool descriptions (product-mappings_create, users_delete-research-board).
patches.reason: The spec-derived descriptions for these two MCP tools were too sparse for agent decision-making. The overrides describe required body shape, destructive semantics, and recommended pairing with related tools.
patches.validated_outcome: Tools-audit pending findings: 3 -> 0; MCP Desc Quality: 9/10 -> 10/10.
